tour.done.toast: That's the tour. The command palette can run it again.
tour.no_repository: Open a repository to see this part of the window.
tour.step.details.body: The selected commit's message, author and files; click a file to see its diff. On the WIP row this is where you stage changes, write a message and commit.
tour.step.details.title: Commit details
tour.step.graph.body: Every commit, with branches and tags drawn where they point. The WIP row at the top holds the changes you haven't committed yet. Click a commit to see what it changed, and right-click it for more.
tour.step.graph.title: The commit graph
tour.step.left.body: Local and remote branches come first, then pull requests, issues, tags, stashes, submodules and worktrees. Click a branch to find it in the graph, double-click to check it out, and right-click any row for its actions.
tour.step.left.title: Branches and more
tour.step.palette.body_open_click: Click Commands at the right of the toolbar to open the command palette: type a few letters of any command, branch or recent repository and press Enter.
tour.step.palette.body_open_key: Press {key} to open the command palette: type a few letters of any command, branch or recent repository and press Enter.
tour.step.palette.sheet_body_palette: Its Keyboard shortcuts entry lists every keyboard shortcut.
tour.step.palette.title: Commands and shortcuts
tour.step.toolbar.body: The everyday actions live along the top: undo and redo, pull, push, a new branch, stash and unstash, pull requests and the terminal. At the right end are the command palette, search and Preferences.
tour.step.toolbar.title: The toolbar
